column2: This  section describes  the version history and changes performed for the current document

column3: Added new entity CECPStatus. It maintains the historical statuses of a CECP.

FLD-CRF-310 and FLD-CRF-322 - corrrected the conformity assessment types.
Two new fields, FLD-CRF-356 and FLD-CRF-357, have been added to store information about a link to a refused certificate and/or withdrawn application. However, these fields will not be visible in the user interface.
FLD-CRF-306 - Status date. Indicates the date when CECP status was updated.
